target_orbit: 400 km, 51.6 deg, 5 years, 1.0 g/cm2 Al equivalent

limitations: literature reports MTJ storage is intrinsically tolerant to heavy-ion bit flips
no target-macro per-bit sigma integrated in v1
do not reuse SRAM 28 nm proxy curves

transient_read.normalization_basis: per active output bit per 0.72 ns read window
limitations: CMOS read periphery only; SOT write path and decoder/control SET absent
RPP area, depth and collection efficiency are pre-layout engineering assumptions
MTJ read chain and Qcrit TSV characterized at summary section 7.1 (10k/20k, TSAEN=2.05ns)
variation envelopes: RSD 6/8/10%, sigma_VOS 4/6/8 mV from summary section 3
proton channel uses silicon LET proxy + same Qcrit samples; do not add to HI probability without union model
proton results are not MTJ storage flips

post_write.normalization_basis: per SOT write pulse (1 ns electrical window)
limitations: selected-path 1T1MTJ + SOT-channel double-exponential Qcrit screen only
hold comparison uses high-Z MTJ proxy (50 kOhm per summary section 3) and weakened write drivers; not intrinsic WER
does not convert Qcrit to dynamic particle cross section
address decoder, control logic and SEFI absent
address decoder, control and SEFI response are not modeled
TNS 2025 reports MgO short-circuit at extreme LET but no permanent-failure rate model
TID corners are CMOS electrical scenarios only
